children: Shares of Omada Health rose after it forecasted continued annual revenue growth of at least 20%.
The stock was up 2.5% at $22.05 as of midday Thursday. Shares have risen 40% this year.

The outlook was part of the healthcare company's long-term financial targets, which it released Thursday. The other targets include an adjusted gross margin of 80% and an adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization margin of 30%.

The targets were informed by "continued progress within Omada's operating framework," the company said, adding that it nearly tripled its member base and revenue between fiscal 2023 and the second quarter of fiscal 2026.

"The scale and momentum we are focusing on across enrollment, engagement, and efficiency give us confidence to update our long-term targets," Chief Executive Sean Duffy said. "This is the moment to push even harder on our mission to bend the curve of chronic disease in America."

Omada said it expects the roughly 10 percentage points of adjusted gross margin expansion compared to the second quarter of 2026 to come about equally from revenue, product-mix benefits, and cost-of-revenue efficiencies.
